test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 27 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

The Government must strive to provide a/an __fair and square__ deal to the citizen of its country.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 2).**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase **"fair and square"** means to be honest and straightforward in one's dealings. (ईमानदार और सीधा-साधा)

 
 
• **Example: **He won the game ***fair and square***, without any cheating.
 
 
 
• **"honest and straightforward"** refers to someone who is truthful and direct in their approach. (ईमानदार और सीधा-साधा)
 
 
• **Example: **She always gives** *honest and straightforward*** feedback, which is appreciated by her colleagues.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. 'honest and straightforward'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Exclusive and unreal **(विशिष्ट और अवास्तविक): Something that is unique but not real.

 
 
• **Example:** The ***exclusive and unreal ***promises made by the salesman were too good to be true.
 
 
 
• **Violent and immoral **(हिंसक और अनैतिक): Actions that involve force and are ethically wrong.
 
 
• **Example: **The ***violent and immoral*** behavior of the gang was condemned by the society.
 
 
 
• **Forward and backward **(आगे और पीछे): Directions or movements towards the front and back.
 
 
• **Example:** The robot can move ***forward and backward*** with ease.
 
 

 

39f:Tf63,

The correct answer is ** Option 3)**
